title: Law to create an annual 9/11 week of service
summary: This bill would require NYC Service or another designated agency to coordinate with community groups, houses of worship, veterans organizations and city agencies to provide volunteer opportunities each year during the week of September 11. It would also require publishing a calendar of volunteer opportunities by August 31 each year. The measure honors those lost on September 11, 2001 and recognizes first responders and volunteers who served afterward.
